name: color-picker
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Color Picker component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. HSV saturation/value drag surface with keyboard arrow-key navigation and accessible per-axis range inputs (AreaThumbSaturationInput/AreaThumbValueInput). The M3 migration queue's dependency note said this item composes label/popover/slider; reading the actual upstream primitive source found it only depends on the already-owned move_interaction/pointer modules (reused unmodified from Wave 2's Slider import), not those three registry items -- a real correction recorded per the M1 lesson to verify against source, not the queue's one-line notes. Requires the `palette` crate directly (matching upstream's own public HSV color type in its props), same as any upstream consumer.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Color Picker" pattern exists; this follows the closest guidance -- the Slider pattern applied per axis. `ColorPicker`/`ColorArea` are `role="group"`; each saturation/value axis input is a native `type="range"` with a human-readable `aria-valuetext` (e.g. "Saturation 62%, vibrant orange") and `aria-orientation` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/color_picker.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: `AreaThumb` is the two-dimensional drag surface and keyboard entry point, handing focus to whichever axis input the keypress moved; each axis then responds to its own arrow keys like an ordinary range input.
